question: Should this issue remain the UX-facing timeline follow-up after the metadata-audit and subagent-lifecycle foundations, or should maintainers consolidate it into one of those open design items?
rationale: The source has enough building blocks for multiple plausible implementations, but choosing persistence owner, public API shape, UI placement, retention, and export/redaction rules is a product/security decision rather than a safe autonomous patch.

options.title: Use audit/lifecycle foundation first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the UX timeline follow-up and require the durable metadata-audit or subagent-lifecycle contract to land before CLI/chat/TUI/export work starts.

options.title: Consolidate into a canonical issue
options.body: Close or narrow this issue after maintainers decide that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38626 fully owns the remaining timeline scope.

options.title: Approve standalone timeline
options.body: Allow a direct timeline implementation now, accepting the risk that it may duplicate or preempt the audit/lifecycle foundation.

recommendation.title: Use audit/lifecycle foundation first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the UX timeline follow-up and require the durable metadata-audit or subagent-lifecycle contract to land before CLI/chat/TUI/export work starts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the related metadata-audit direction and appears in recent state/subagent history that would determine the durable owner boundary.
